raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
\pmb {\mu} _ {\mathrm {d}} = \frac {g _ {\mathrm {d}} e}{2 m _ {\mathrm {d}}} \pmb {S} _ {\mathrm {d}};
$$

筑核的 $g$ 因子为1. 1.
raw_problem.solution_text:
由方程 (7.93)，荒原子的超细结构能量修正应为

$$
E _ {\mathrm {h f}} ^ {1} = \frac {\mu_ {0} g _ {\mathrm {d}} e ^ {2}}{3 \pi m _ {\mathrm {d}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} a ^ {3}} \left\langle \mathbf {S} _ {\mathrm {d}} \cdot \mathbf {S} _ {\mathrm {e}} \right\rangle = \frac {\mu_ {0} g _ {\mathrm {d}} e ^ {2}}{3 \pi m _ {\mathrm {d}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} a ^ {3}} \frac {1}{2} \left\langle S ^ {2} - S _ {\mathrm {d}} ^ {2} - S _ {\mathrm {e}} ^ {2} \right\rangle .
$$

?在核子的自旋为 ，所以 $S _ { \mathrm d } ^ { 2 } = S _ { \mathrm d } \left( S _ { \mathrm d } + 1 \right) \hbar ^ { 2 } = 2 \hbar ^ { 2 }$ 电子 $S _ { \mathrm { e } } ^ { 2 } = S _ { \mathrm { e } } \left( S _ { \mathrm { e } } + 1 \right) = 3 \hbar ^ { 2 } / 4$ ，总自旋量子数为 $3 / 2 , 1 / 2$ ，所以 $S ^ { 2 } = S \left( S + 1 \right) = 1 5 \hbar ^ { 2 } / 4 , 3 \hbar ^ { 2 } / 4 .$ ，因此

$$
E _ {\mathrm {h f}} ^ {1} = \frac {\mu_ {0} g _ {\mathrm {d}} e ^ {2}}{6 \pi m _ {\mathrm {d}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} a ^ {3}} \left\langle \pmb {S} ^ {2} - \pmb {S} _ {\mathrm {d}} ^ {2} - \pmb {S} _ {\mathrm {e}} ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {\mu_ {0} g _ {\mathrm {d}} e ^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{6 \pi m _ {\mathrm {d}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} a ^ {3}}, & S ^ {2} = 1 5 \hbar^ {2} / 4 \\ - 2 \frac {\mu_ {0} g _ {\mathrm {d}} e ^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{6 \pi m _ {\mathrm {d}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} a ^ {3}}, & S ^ {2} = 3 \hbar^ {2} / 4 \end{array} \right..
$$

两个能级的能量差为

$$
\Delta E = \frac {\mu_ {0} g _ {\mathrm {d}} e ^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{2 \pi m _ {\mathrm {d}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} a ^ {3}} = \frac {g _ {\mathrm {d}} e ^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} m _ {\mathrm {d}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} c ^ {2} a ^ {3}}, \quad \left(\mu_ {0} \varepsilon_ {0} \equiv 1 / c ^ {2}\right).
$$

把这个能量差用氢原子的超细结构能量差表示(荒原子的玻尔半径与氢原子的玻尔半径近似一样)

$$
\Delta E _ {\mathrm {h y d r o g e n}} = \frac {\mu_ {0} g _ {\mathrm {p}} e ^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{3 \pi m _ {\mathrm {p}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} a ^ {3}} = \frac {g _ {\mathrm {p}} e ^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{3 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} m _ {\mathrm {p}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} c ^ {2} a ^ {3}},
$$

$$
\Delta E = \left(\frac {g _ {\mathrm {d}}}{g _ {\mathrm {p}}}\right) \left(\frac {m _ {\mathrm {p}}}{m _ {\mathrm {d}}}\right) \left(\frac {3}{2}\right) \frac {g _ {\mathrm {p}} e ^ {2} \hbar^ {2}}{3 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} m _ {\mathrm {p}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} c ^ {2} a ^ {3}} = \left(\frac {g _ {\mathrm {d}}}{g _ {\mathrm {p}}}\right) \left(\frac {m _ {\mathrm {p}}}{m _ {\mathrm {d}}}\right) \left(\frac {3}{2}\right) \Delta E _ {\text {h y d r o g e n}},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \lambda_ {\mathrm {d}} = \frac {c}{v _ {\mathrm {d}}} = \frac {c h}{\Delta E} = \left(\frac {2}{3}\right) \left(\frac {g _ {\mathrm {p}}}{g _ {\mathrm {d}}}\right) \left(\frac {m _ {\mathrm {d}}}{m _ {\mathrm {p}}}\right) \frac {c h}{\Delta E _ {\mathrm {h y d r o g e n}}} = \left(\frac {2}{3}\right) \left(\frac {g _ {\mathrm {p}}}{g _ {\mathrm {d}}}\right) \left(\frac {m _ {\mathrm {d}}}{m _ {\mathrm {p}}}\right) \lambda_ {\mathrm {h}} \\ = \left(\frac {2}{3}\right) \left(\frac {5 . 5 9}{1 . 7 1}\right) (2) (2 1 \mathrm {c m}) = 9 1. 5 3 2 \mathrm {c m}. \\ \end{array}
$$

串串串习题 7.48 晶体中，原子能级受到相邻离子产生电场的微扰.作为粗略模型，假设一个氢原子被三对点电荷包围，如图 7.8 所示. (自旋与该问题无关，故将其忽略.)

(a) 假设 $r \ll d _ { 1 } , r \ll d _ { 2 } , r \ll d _ { 3 }$ ，证明:

$$
H ^ {\prime} = V _ {0} + 3 \left(\beta_ {1} x ^ {2} + \beta_ {2} y ^ {2} + \beta_ {3} z ^ {2}\right) - (\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}) r ^ {2},
$$

其中

$$
\beta_ {i} \equiv - \frac {e}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {q _ {i}}{d _ {i} ^ {3}} \text {和} V _ {0} = 2 \left(\beta_ {1} d _ {1} ^ {2} + \beta_ {2} d _ {2} ^ {2} + \beta_ {3} d _ {3} ^ {2}\right).
$$

(b) 求基态能量的最低阶修正.

(c) 分别计算下列情况下的第一激发态 $( n = 2 )$ ) 的能量一阶修正.求出该四重简并体系分裂为几个能级: (i) 立方对称情况， $\beta _ { 1 } = \beta _ { 2 } = \beta _ { 3 }$ (ii) 四方对称情况，$\beta _ { 1 } = \beta _ { 2 } \neq \beta _ { 3 }$ 一般的正交对称情况(三个都不相同).注意你可能从习题中得到"好"态.

![](images/16cae3a3533e31ee15b2788464bb72e1bc97ac9dec07b49320f728b62d7f01aa.jpg)  
7.8 被六个点电荷包围的氢原子(晶格的粗略模型)

解答 (叫氢原子中的电子(坐标为 $( x , y , z )$ 与一对点电荷 $q$ (处在 $( \pm d , 0 , 0 )$ ) 的相互作用势能为

$$
V = - \frac {e q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {(x + d) ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}}} + \frac {1}{\sqrt {(x - d) + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}}} \right],
$$

由于 $d \gg x , y , z$ 可将其展开

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {1}{\sqrt {(x + d) ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}}} \\ = \left(x ^ {2} + 2 d x + d ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}\right) ^ {- 1 / 2} = \left(d ^ {2} + 2 d x + r ^ {2}\right) ^ {- 1 / 2} \\ = \frac {1}{d} \left(1 + \frac {2 x}{d} + \frac {r ^ {2}}{d ^ {2}}\right) ^ {- 1 / 2} \approx \frac {1}{d} \left[ 1 - \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {2 x}{d} + \frac {r ^ {2}}{d ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {3}{8} \left(\frac {2 x}{d} + \frac {r ^ {2}}{d ^ {2}}\right) ^ {2} \right] \\ = \frac {1}{d} \left[ 1 - \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {2 x}{d} + \frac {r ^ {2}}{d ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {3}{8} \frac {4 x ^ {2}}{d ^ {2}} \right] = \frac {1}{d} \left[ 1 - \frac {x}{d} + \frac {1}{2 d ^ {2}} \left(3 x ^ {2} - r ^ {2}\right) \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

势能由此可表示为

$$
\begin{array}{l} V = - \frac {e q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{d} \left[ 1 - \frac {x}{d} + \frac {1}{2 d ^ {2}} \left(3 x ^ {2} - r ^ {2}\right) + 1 + \frac {x}{d} + \frac {1}{2 d ^ {2}} \left(3 x ^ {2} - r ^ {2}\right) \right] \\ = - \frac {e q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} d ^ {3}} \left[ 2 d ^ {2} + \left(3 x ^ {2} - r ^ {2}\right) \right] \\ = 2 \beta d ^ {2} + 3 \beta x ^ {2} - \beta r ^ {2}, \quad \beta \equiv - \frac {e q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} d ^ {3}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

另外两对点电荷(处在 $( 0 , \pm d _ { 2 } , 0 ) , ( 0 , 0 , \pm d _ { 3 } ) )$ ))的势也可以求出，因此微扰哈密顿量为

$$
\begin{array}{l} H ^ {\prime} = 2 \left(\beta_ {1} d _ {1} ^ {2} + \beta_ {2} d _ {2} ^ {2} + \beta_ {3} d _ {3} ^ {2}\right) + 3 \left(\beta_ {1} x ^ {2} + \beta_ {2} y ^ {2} + \beta_ {3} z ^ {2}\right) - r ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}\right) \\ = V _ {0} + 3 \left(\beta_ {1} x ^ {2} + \beta_ {2} y ^ {2} + \beta_ {3} z ^ {2}\right) - r ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}\right). \\ \end{array}
$$

(b) 基态非筒并，一阶能量修正为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle 1 0 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 1 0 0 \rangle = \langle 1 0 0 | V _ {0} | 1 0 0 \rangle \\ + 3 \left[ \beta_ {1} \langle 1 0 0 | x ^ {2} | 1 0 0 \rangle + \beta_ {2} \langle 1 0 0 | y ^ {2} | 1 0 0 \rangle + \beta_ {3} \langle 1 0 0 | z ^ {2} | 1 0 0 \rangle \right] \\ - \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}\right) \langle 1 0 0 | r ^ {2} | 1 0 0 \rangle . \\ \end{array}
$$

在球坐标下: $x = r \sin \theta \cos \phi , y = r \sin \theta \sin \phi , z = r \cos \theta ,$ ,

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle 1 0 0 | x ^ {2} | 1 0 0 \rangle = \int R _ {1 0} ^ {*} R _ {1 0} r ^ {4} \mathrm {d} r \frac {1}{4 \pi} \iint \sin^ {2} \theta \cos^ {2} \phi \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = \frac {1}{\pi a ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} r ^ {4} \mathrm {d} r \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {3} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \cos^ {2} \phi \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = \frac {1}{\pi a ^ {3}} \left(\frac {a}{2}\right) ^ {5} 4! \frac {4}{3} \pi = a ^ {2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

同理: $\left. 1 0 0 \right| y ^ { 2 } \left| 1 0 0 \right. = \left. 1 0 0 \right| z ^ { 2 } \left| 1 0 0 \right. = a ^ { 2 }$ , (1001 r21100) = 3α2

于是基态能量一阶修正为

$$
\langle 1 0 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 1 0 0 \rangle = V _ {0} + 3 (\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}) a ^ {2} - 3 (\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}) a ^ {2} = V _ {0}.
$$

(c) 第一激发态 $( n = 2$ ) 四重简并， 个态分别为

$$
\begin{array}{l} | 1 \rangle = | 2 0 0 \rangle = R _ {2 0} Y _ {0} ^ {0}, \qquad | 2 \rangle = | 2 1 1 \rangle = R _ {2 1} Y _ {1} ^ {1}, \\ \left| 3 \right\rangle = \left| 2 1 - 1 \right\rangle = R _ {2 1} Y _ {1} ^ {- 1}, \quad \left| 4 \right\rangle = \left| 2 1 0 \right\rangle = R _ {2 1} Y _ {1} ^ {0}. \\ \end{array}
$$

计算微扰矩阵的矩阵元，对角矩阵元有如下形式:

$$
\langle n \ell m | H ^ {\prime} | n \ell m \rangle = V _ {0} + 3 \left(\beta_ {1} \left\langle x ^ {2} \right\rangle + \beta_ {2} \left\langle y ^ {2} \right\rangle + \beta_ {3} \left\langle z ^ {2} \right\rangle\right) - \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}\right) \left\langle r ^ {2} \right\rangle .
$$

对于 00) $Y _ { 0 } ^ { 0 }$ 不依赖于 $\theta , \phi$ 份，披函数具有球对称性，所以，

$$
\left\langle x ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle y ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle z ^ {2} \right\rangle = \frac {1}{3} \left\langle r ^ {2} \right\rangle \Rightarrow \left\langle 2 0 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 0 0 \right\rangle = V _ {0}.
$$

对于 210) 由习题 7.44(时，得 $\left. r ^ { 2 } \right. = { \frac { n ^ { 2 } a ^ { 2 } } { 2 } } \left[ 5 n ^ { 2 } - 3 \ell \left( \ell + 1 \right) + 1 \right] \underset { n = 2 , \ell = 1 } { \Rightarrow } \left. r ^ { 2 } \right. = 3 0 a ^ { 2 } ,$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle x ^ {2} \right\rangle = \{\dots \} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \cos^ {2} \phi \mathrm {d} \phi = \{\dots \} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \sin^ {2} \phi \mathrm {d} \phi = \left\langle y ^ {2} \right\rangle , \\ \left\langle z ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle 2 1 0 \right| z ^ {2} | 2 1 0 \rangle = \frac {1}{2 \pi a} \frac {1}{1 6 a ^ {4}} \int r ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \cos^ {2} \theta \left(r ^ {2} \cos^ {2} \theta\right) r ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = \frac {1}{1 6 a ^ {5}} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r ^ {6} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \mathrm {d} r \int_ {o} ^ {\pi} \cos^ {4} \theta \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta = \frac {1}{1 6 a ^ {5}} 6! a ^ {7} \frac {2}{5} = 1 8 a ^ {2}, \\ \left\langle x ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle y ^ {2} \right\rangle = \frac {1}{2} \left(\left\langle r ^ {2} \right\rangle - \left\langle z ^ {2} \right\rangle\right) = \frac {1}{2} \left(3 0 a ^ {2} - 1 8 a ^ {2}\right) = 6 a ^ {2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle 2 1 0 \right| H ^ {\prime} | 2 1 0 \rangle = V _ {0} + 3 \left(6 a ^ {2} \beta_ {1} + 6 a ^ {2} \beta_ {2} + 1 8 a ^ {2} \beta_ {3}\right) - 3 0 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}\right) \\ = V _ {0} - 1 2 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}\right) + 3 6 a ^ {2} \beta_ {3}. \\ \end{array}
$$

对于 $\left| 2 1 \pm 1 \right.$ 态：

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle z ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle 2 1 \pm 1 \right| z ^ {2} | 2 1 \pm 1 \rangle = \frac {1}{\pi a} \frac {1}{6 4 a ^ {4}} \int r ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \sin^ {2} \theta (r ^ {2} \cos^ {2} \theta) r ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = \frac {1}{3 2 a ^ {5}} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r ^ {6} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \mathrm {d} r \int_ {o} ^ {\pi} \left(1 - \cos^ {2} \theta\right) \cos^ {2} \theta \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \\ = \frac {1}{3 2 a ^ {5}} 6! a ^ {7} \left(\frac {2}{3} - \frac {2}{5}\right) _ {1} = 6 a ^ {2}, \\ \left\langle x ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle y ^ {2} \right\rangle = \frac {1}{2} \left(\left\langle r ^ {2} \right\rangle - \left\langle z ^ {2} \right\rangle\right) = \frac {1}{2} \left(3 0 a ^ {2} - 6 a ^ {2}\right) = 1 2 a ^ {2}, \\ \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle 2 1 \pm 1 \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| 2 1 \pm 1 \right\rangle = V _ {0} + 3 \left(1 2 a ^ {2} \beta_ {1} + 1 2 a ^ {2} \beta_ {2} + 6 a ^ {2} \beta_ {3}\right) - 3 0 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}\right) \\ = V _ {0} + 6 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}\right) - 1 8 a ^ {2} \beta_ {3}. \\ \end{array}
$$

个非对角元

$$
\langle 2 0 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 1 0 \rangle , \quad \langle 2 0 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 1 \pm 1 \rangle , \quad \langle 2 1 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 1 \pm 1 \rangle , \quad \langle 2 1 - 1 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 1 1 \rangle .
$$

由不同态函数的正交归一性，得 $\langle n \ell m | V _ { 0 } | n ^ { \prime } \ell ^ { \prime } m ^ { \prime } \rangle = 0$ 由 $Y _ { \ell } ^ { m }$ 的正交归一性，得

$$
\langle n \ell m | r ^ {2} | n ^ {\prime} \ell^ {\prime} m ^ {\prime} \rangle = 0 \Rightarrow \langle x ^ {2} \rangle + \langle y ^ {2} \rangle + \langle z ^ {2} \rangle = 0.
$$

对于 $\left. 2 0 0 \right| x ^ { 2 } \left| 2 1 \pm 1 \right.$ 和 $\left. 2 1 0 \right| x ^ { 2 } \left| 2 1 \pm 1 \right.$ ，积分中关于 $\phi$ 的表达式为

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \cos^ {2} \phi \mathrm {e} ^ {\pm \mathrm {i} \phi} \mathrm {d} \phi = \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \cos^ {3} \phi \mathrm {d} \phi \pm \mathrm {i} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \cos^ {2} \phi \sin \phi \mathrm {d} \phi = 0.
$$

对于 $\left. y ^ { 2 } \right.$ 也有同样的结果，所以 $\left. z ^ { 2 } \right. = 0 , \left. r ^ { 2 } \right. = 0$ ,

$$
\langle 2 0 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 1 \pm 1 \rangle = \langle 2 1 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 1 \pm 1 \rangle = 0.
$$

对于 $\left. 2 0 0 \right| x ^ { 2 } \left| 2 1 0 \right.$ 和 $\left. 2 0 0 \right| y ^ { 2 } \left| 2 1 0 \right.$ ，积分中关于 $\theta$ 的积分为

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos \theta \sin^ {2} \theta \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta = 0,
$$

所以

$$
\langle 2 0 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 1 0 \rangle = 0.
$$

对于 $\left. 2 1 - 1 | H ^ { \prime } | 2 1 1 \right.$ :

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle 2 1 - 1 | x ^ {2} | 2 1 1 \rangle = - \frac {1}{\pi a} \frac {1}{6 4 a ^ {4}} \int r ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \sin^ {2} \theta \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \mathrm {i} \phi} (r ^ {2} \sin^ {2} \theta \cos^ {2} \phi) r ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {1}{6 4 \pi a ^ {5}} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r ^ {6} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \mathrm {d} r \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {5} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \mathrm {i} \phi} \cos^ {2} \phi \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {1}{6 4 \pi a ^ {5}} 6! a ^ {7} \frac {1 6}{1 5} \frac {\pi}{2} = - 6 a ^ {2}, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle 2 1 - 1 | y ^ {2} | 2 1 1 \rangle = - \frac {1}{\pi a} \frac {1}{6 4 a ^ {4}} \int r ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \sin^ {2} \theta \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \mathrm {i} \phi} (r ^ {2} \sin^ {2} \theta \sin^ {2} \phi) r ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {1}{6 4 \pi a ^ {5}} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r ^ {6} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \mathrm {d} r \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {5} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin^ {2} \phi \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {1}{6 4 \pi a ^ {5}} 6! a ^ {7} \frac {1 6}{1 5} \left(- \frac {\pi}{2}\right) = 6 a ^ {2}, \\ \left\langle z ^ {2} \right\rangle = 0 - \left\langle x ^ {2} \right\rangle - \left\langle y ^ {2} \right\rangle = 0, \\ \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
\left\langle 2 1 - 1 \right| H ^ {\prime} | 2 1 1 \rangle = 3 \left[ \beta_ {1} \left(- 6 a ^ {2}\right) + \beta_ {2} \left(6 a ^ {2}\right) \right] = - 1 8 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} - \beta_ {2}\right).
$$

最后得到微扰矩阵为

$$
\left( \begin{array}{c c c c} V _ {0} & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & V _ {0} - 1 2 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2}\right) + 2 4 a ^ {2} \beta_ {3} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & V _ {0} + 6 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2}\right) - 1 2 a ^ {2} \beta_ {3} & - 1 8 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} - \beta_ {2}\right) \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 8 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} - \beta_ {2}\right) & V _ {0} + 6 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2}\right) - 1 2 a ^ {2} \beta_ {3} \end{array} \right)
$$

久期方程为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left| \begin{array}{c c c c} H _ {1 1} ^ {\prime} - E _ {2} ^ {(1)} & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & H _ {2 2} ^ {\prime} - E _ {2} ^ {(1)} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & H _ {3 3} ^ {\prime} - E _ {2} ^ {(1)} & H _ {3 4} ^ {\prime} \\ 0 & 0 & H _ {4 3} ^ {\prime} & H _ {4 4} ^ {\prime} - E _ {2} ^ {(1)} \end{array} \right| = 0 \\ \Rightarrow \left(H _ {1 1} ^ {\prime} - E _ {2} ^ {(1)}\right) \left(H _ {2 2} ^ {\prime} - E _ {2} ^ {(1)}\right) \left[ \left(H _ {3 3} ^ {\prime} - E _ {2} ^ {(1)}\right) ^ {2} - H _ {3 4} ^ {\prime} H _ {4 3} ^ {\prime} \right] = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

由此可解得能量的一阶修正为

$$
\varepsilon_ {1} = E _ {2 1} ^ {(1)} = H _ {1 1} ^ {\prime} = V _ {0},
$$

$$
\varepsilon_ {2} = E _ {2 2} ^ {(1)} = H _ {2 2} ^ {\prime} = V _ {0} - 1 2 a ^ {2} \left(\beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} - 2 \beta_ {3}\right),
$$

$$
\varepsilon_ {3} = E _ {2 3} ^ {(1)} = H _ {3 3} ^ {\prime} - H _ {3 4} ^ {\prime} = V _ {0} - 1 2 a ^ {2} \left(- 2 \beta_ {1} + \beta_ {2} + \beta_ {3}\right),
$$

$$
